title: How is Zeus connected to The Rock?
description:
A painting from the Aeneid, Caesar's own coins, Rome's emperors and the line of popes connect the king of the Greek gods to The Rock.

Zeus → Venus → Julius Caesar → Constantine the Great → Pope Sylvester I → Pope Francis → Jimmy Fallon → The Rock

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Zeus → Venus: In the Aeneid, Venus pleads with her father Jupiter, the Roman Zeus, to protect her son Aeneas.
   Photo by anonymous, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:British_(English)_School_-_Venus_Petitioning_Jupiter_on_behalf_of_Aeneas_-_653231_-_National_Trust.jpg
2. Venus → Julius Caesar: Caesar's family claimed descent from Aeneas, so in 44 BC his coins paired his face with Venus.
   Photo by CNG, CC BY-SA 2.5: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gaius_Julius_Caesar,_denarius,_44_BC,_RRC_480-3.jpg
3. Julius Caesar → Constantine (63 portraits, every holder): Caesar's heir Augustus became Rome's first emperor, and the line of emperors ran to Constantine the Great.
